Rendered examples of
[huesken-org/quarto-explain](https://github.com/huesken-org/quarto-explain). Each
row is one `.qmd` file rendered to every target it supports.

## The tour

`index.qmd` — `explain`, `stepper` and `code-mark`.

| | |
|---|---|
| [Slides](slides.html) | reveal fragments, the code highlighted along with them |
| [Web page](website.html) | numbered badges on the lines, a button stepper |
| [Handout (PDF)](handout.pdf) | line numbers and a list |

## The manim constructs

`manim.qmd` — animations driven by the same steps.

| | |
|---|---|
| [Slides](manim-slides.html) | the animation plays up to the current step |
| [Web page](manim-website.html) | the same, driven by buttons |
| [Handout (PDF)](manim-handout.pdf) | the still frame of each section |

## Configurable wording

`localised.qmd` — the six labels the extensions write themselves, in German.

| | |
|---|---|
| [Web page](localised-website.html) | `Vorheriger Schritt` / `Nächster Schritt` |
| [Handout (PDF)](localised-handout.pdf) | `Zeile 1`, `Zeilen 1–2`, `links` / `rechts` |
